parameters.name: fill_side
parameters.meaning: which end of each red bar supplies the recolored half

parameters.name: rounding
parameters.meaning: floor or ceil when half the bar height is non-integral

input_constraints: Inputs retain the selected task's separated red vertical bars. Every pair contains odd and even bar heights; top/bottom selection and floor/ceil therefore change observable output cells.
invariant_reasoning: recolor that many cells cyan from the episode-selected end

episodes.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((all-objs (objects g 0))
                  (red-bars (filter (lambda (o) (= 2 (obj-color o))) all-objs)))
             (reduce (lambda (grid bar)
                       (let* ((cells (obj-cells bar))
                              (rs (map first cells))
                              (r1 (min-list rs))
                              (r2 (max-list rs))
                              (bar-h (+ 1 (- r2 r1)))
                              (half-h (quotient bar-h 2))
                              (cyan-start (- r2 (- half-h 1))))
                         (reduce (lambda (gr cell)
                                   (let ((r (first cell))
                                         (c (second cell)))
                                     (if (>= r cyan-start) (set-cell gr r c 8) gr)))
                                 grid
                                 cells)))
                     g
                     red-bars)))))

limitations: Prototype only; no setting is wired into production generation or approved as canonical authority.
Evidence covers one deterministic episode per allowed setting and the three declared parameter rivals, not all seeds or all plausible rules.
The family remains restricted to separated one-column red bars; arbitrary red shapes are outside this prototype.
